title: pebble web service via nightscout shows incorrect IOB when user enters long acting...
body: Since the feature of long acting insulin inputs started, the nightscout pebble web service endpoint shows both the short and long acting inputs. For example, I administered 24 units of toujeo this AM and entered that into xdrip for my long acting.  When I look at the nightscount pebble endpoint, the IOB shows that 24 units plus whatever bolus is on board.  Would like to NOT see that long acting as part of that IOB.  Not sure if this is a nightscout issue or xdrip but figured I'd start here.

comments.body: @gitanO0 Do you know if this still happens?
